H5101.gloss: to bray (as an ass), scream (from hunger)

H5102.gloss: to sparkle, i.e. (figuratively) be cheerful; hence (from the sheen of a running stream) to flow, i.e. (figuratively) assemble

H5104.gloss: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity

H5106.gloss: to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize

H5107.gloss: to germinate, i.e. (figuratively) to (causatively, make) flourish; also (of words), to utter

H5110.gloss: to nod, i.e. waver; figuratively, to wander, flee, disappear; also (from shaking the head in sympathy), to console, deplore, or (from tossing the head in scorn) taunt

H5115.gloss: to rest (as at home); causatively (through the implied idea of beauty ), to celebrate (with praises)
H5115.definition:
a primitive root; (compare H5116 (נָוֶה))
to rest (as at home); causatively (through the implied idea of beauty ), to celebrate (with praises)
KJV: keept at home, prepare an habitation.

H5116.gloss: (adjectively) at home; hence (by implication of satisfaction) lovely; also (noun) a home, of God (temple), men (residence), flocks (pasture), or wild animals (den)

H5117.gloss: to rest, i.e. settle down; used in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, intransitive, transitive and causative (to dwell, stay, let fall, place, let alone, withdraw, give comfort, etc.)

H5125.gloss: to resprout, i.e. propagate by shoots; figuratively, to be perpetual

H5126.gloss: Nun or Non, the father of Joshua
H5126.definition:
or נוֹן; (1 Chronicles 7:27), from H5125 (נוּן); perpetuity,
Nun or Non, the father of Joshua
KJV: Non, Nun.

H5127.gloss: to flit, i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver)

H5128.gloss: to waver, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined)

H5129.gloss: Noadjah, the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess

H5130.gloss: to quiver (i.e. vibrate up and down, or rock to and fro); used in a great variety of applications (including sprinkling, beckoning, rubbing, bastinadoing, sawing, waving, etc.)

H5132.gloss: properly, to flash; hence, to blossom (from the brilliancy of color); also, to fly away (from the quickness of motion)

H5133.gloss: a pinion (or wing feather); often (collectively) plumage

H5137.gloss: to spirt, i.e. besprinkle (especially in expiation)

H5139.gloss: separate, i.e. consecrated (as prince, a Nazirite); hence (figuratively from the latter) an unpruned vine (like an unshorn Nazirite)

H5140.gloss: to drip, or shed by trickling

H5144.gloss: to hold aloof, i.e. (intransitivey) abstain (from food and drink, from impurity, and even from divine worship (i.e. apostatize)); specifically, to set apart (to sacred purposes), i.e. devote

H5145.gloss: properly, something set apart, i.e. (abstractly) dedication (of a priet or Nazirite); hence (concretely) unshorn locks; also (by implication) a chaplet (especially of royalty)

H5146.gloss: Noach, the patriarch of the flood

H5148.gloss: to guide; by implication, to transport (into exile, or as colonists)

H5152.gloss: Nochor, the name of the grandfather and a brother of Abraham

H5157.gloss: to inherit (as a (figurative) mode of descent), or (generally) to occupy; causatively, to bequeath, or (generally) distribute, instate

H5158.gloss: a stream, especially a winter torrent; (by implication) a (narrow) valley (in which a brook runs); also a shaft (of a mine)

H5159.gloss: properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion

H5160.gloss: Nachaliel, a place in the Desert

H5161.gloss: a Nechelamite, or descendant of Nechlam

H5162.gloss: properly, to sigh, i.e. breathe strongly; by implication, to be sorry, i.e. (in a favorable sense) to pity, console or (reflexively) rue; or (unfavorably) to avenge (oneself)

H5166.gloss: Nechemjah, the name of three Israelites

H5172.gloss: properly, to hiss, i.e. whisper a (magic) spell; generally, to prognosticate

H5176.gloss: Nachash, the name of two persons apparently non-Israelite

H5178.gloss: copper, hence, something made of that metal, i.e. coin, a fetter; figuratively, base (as compared with gold or silver)

H5180.gloss: something made of copper, i.e. the copper serpent of the Desert

H5181.gloss: to sink, i.e. descend; causatively, to press or lead down

H5182.gloss: to descend; causatively, to bring away, deposit, depose

H5183.gloss: a descent, i.e. imposition, unfavorable (punishment) or favorable (food); restfulness

H5184.gloss: Nachath, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites

H5186.gloss: to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application

H5188.gloss: a pendant for the ears (especially of pearls)

H5190.gloss: to lift; by implication, to impose

H5193.gloss: properly, to strike in, i.e. fix; specifically, to plant (literally or figuratively)

H5194.gloss: a plant; collectively, a plantation; abstractly, a planting

H5197.gloss: to ooze, i.e. distil gradually; by implication, to fall in drops; figuratively, to speak by inspiration

H5198.gloss: a drop; specifically, an aromatic gum (probably stacte)
